Rear panel → ConnectX-7 → PCIe Gen5 switch → GPU → NVSwitch; BlueField-3 and BMC hang off the CPUs
4 twin-port cages × 2 ports = 8 × 400G; node side = flat-top OSFP, switch side = finned OSFP
4 twin-port cages × 2 ports = 8 × 400G; node side = flat-top OSFP, switch side = finned OSFP
NVLink 4: 18 links per GPU spread across 4 NVSwitches → 900 GB/s bidirectional per GPU; every GPU reaches every other at full rate
PCIe switches 1–2 uplink to CPU 0, 3–4 to CPU 1.
GPUDirect RDMA stays below the switch: GPU n ↔ mlx5_n
